subject: dsa
title: Happy Number
summary: Repeatedly replace the number with the sum of the squares of its digits. If the chain reaches 1 the number is happy; if it ever revisits a value it has entered a cycle and never will.
problem: Determine whether a number is happy: repeatedly summing the squares of its digits eventually reaches 1.

steps.caption: Replace the number with the sum of the squares of its digits, over and over. Reaching 1 means happy; revisiting a number means a loop.
The chain reached 1, so 19 is a happy number. (A non-happy number would instead cycle without ever hitting 1.)
